name: Radial attention (sparse by frame distance)
plain: Sparse temporal self-attention where each token attends to nearby frames densely, and to far frames in narrow windows that shrink with distance, plus occasional full far frames. Early dense steps are kept. The mask builds per sequence and runs through a block-sparse Sage kernel.
math:
dist=|i−j|, group=bit_length(dist).
Window width: dist<1 → tokens per frame; dist=1 → half; else max(2^bits(T)/2^group·decay, block_size).
Diagonal split: decay_length=2^bits(T)/2^group, if ≥block_size full; else factor=int(block/decay); full only when dist%factor==0.
Block mask: a block counts if >60% of its nonzero columns have density>⅓.
Dense steps first; RadialSpargeSageAttn on block mask.
